params.body:
## One recommended plan, everywhere
- **/pricing:** "Most popular" was a button that did nothing. It is now a label, "Most teams choose this", on Decode.
- **/services:** the green border and the label sat on Signal ("Editorial layer"), while the editorial layer (the reports) is Decode's, and Decode already had the filled button. Both now sit on Decode.

## The right door per plan on /services
- Signal said "Create a free account", but it is paid. Logged-in users saw "Included in your membership" whatever their plan.
- Every card now matches /pricing: "Choose Signal", "Choose Decode" (filled), and "Talk to the team" for Intelligence.

## One description per plan
- **Signal** no longer promises "a limited number of curated reports per month". Reports are in Decode, as the /pricing table already said.
- **Intelligence** is "Everything in Decode, plus a quarterly read on the category you choose", as on /pricing. Workshops, keynotes and custom research are scoped separately with Trendwolves.

## No beta promise that is not true
"Free while we are in beta" and "create a free account and you have full access during the beta" stopped being true with #148. A free account is Explore, and a paid plan goes through the contact form until payments are live. The page now says: "Paid plans open at launch; ask us for early access". "No enterprise tiers" is gone too.

## A new report every month
Trendwolves commits to a monthly report.
- **/reports:** the calendar table (codes and a date per report up to August 2027) is replaced by "A new report every month". The reports that are out appear with their cover; the titles coming next are listed without a date.
- **/pricing table:** Decode and Intelligence show "A new report every month, and every one before it".
- **/services:** Decode lists "A new editorial report every month".
- **Home:** the link under the reports reads "A new report every month".

## The home price band in three sentences
"The latest posts and the weekly letter are free. Signal opens the whole archive for EUR 14.99 a month. Most teams choose Decode, which adds a new report every month: EUR 299 a month on an annual plan." Names and prices still come from `Plan`.

## The confirm link lands on its own page
After confirming, the link redirected to `/`. While the cover is on, that is the cover, with the signup form again, so it looked as if nothing had happened.
- It now lands on `/newsletter/confirmed`: "You are on the list", with wording for before and after launch.
- The page is open behind the cover. A test checks that it does not show the cover.

Tests: 340 passing. /pricing, /services, /reports, the home band and the confirm page checked locally at 1440 px.
params.title: Pricing and services say one thing, a report every month, and the confirm link lands on its own page
